seoTitle: Free Online Stopwatch - Precision Timer with Laps
metaDescription: A free, easy-to-use online stopwatch. Track time with millisecond precision, record lap times, and manage your activities efficiently.
intro: Need to measure exactly how long something takes? Our free online stopwatch provides precision timing directly in your browser—no app downloads, no account required. Whether you are timing a workout, measuring a cooking process, tracking how long a presentation runs, or conducting a science experiment, this stopwatch delivers accurate elapsed time measurement down to the hundredth of a second. It features start, stop, lap, and reset controls, making it a versatile tool for any scenario that demands precise time tracking.
whatIs: A stopwatch is a time-measurement instrument that counts upward from zero, recording the total elapsed time from the moment you press Start until you press Stop. Our digital implementation brings this classic tool to your browser with enhanced features like lap timing, which lets you record intermediate split times without stopping the main clock. Unlike a countdown timer that alerts you after a set duration, a stopwatch is open-ended—it simply measures how long an activity takes. This makes it essential for athletic training, scientific experiments, productivity tracking, and any task where knowing the exact duration after the fact is more important than setting a limit in advance.
howToUse: Click the 'Start' button (Play icon) to begin measuring time.
While the stopwatch is running, click the 'Lap' button (Flag icon) to record intermediate split times.
Click the 'Pause' button to temporarily stop the time.
Click the 'Reset' button to clear the time and start over.
howItWorks: When you press Start, the stopwatch records the precise current timestamp using the browser's high-resolution performance timer. On every animation frame (approximately 60 times per second), it calculates the difference between the current time and the start time to determine the total elapsed duration. This approach ensures accuracy even if the browser tab is briefly throttled. The Lap button records the current elapsed time as a split without stopping the clock, allowing you to track individual segments of a longer activity. The Stop button freezes the display at the current elapsed time, and Reset clears everything back to 00:00.00.
workedExample: Suppose you are training for a 5K run and want to track your lap times around a 400-meter track. You press Start as you begin running. After completing the first lap (400 m), you press the Lap button. The stopwatch records the split time of 1:48.32 while continuing to run. After the second lap, you press Lap again—it records 3:41.15. You continue for a total of 12.5 laps (5,000 m) and press Stop. The main display shows your total time of 23:17.84, and the lap list shows each individual 400 m split, allowing you to analyze your pacing and identify which laps were fastest or slowest.
resultInterpretation: The main display shows total elapsed time in the format MM:SS.cc (minutes, seconds, and centiseconds). If you recorded laps, each lap entry shows the cumulative time at the moment the Lap button was pressed. To calculate individual lap durations, subtract the previous lap time from the current one. For example, if Lap 1 is 1:48.32 and Lap 2 is 3:41.15, the second lap took 1:52.83. This split analysis is critical for athletes who need to understand their pacing consistency. The stopwatch continues running until explicitly stopped, so there is no upper limit on the duration it can measure.
useCases: Sports & Athletics: Timing sprints, swimming laps, or overall workout duration.
Presentations: Rehearsing a speech to ensure you stay within your allotted time limit.
Productivity: Tracking exactly how long a specific work task takes to complete.
tipsAndLimitations: To ensure maximum accuracy, avoid putting your browser tab to sleep or minimizing the window for long periods.
The tool records up to 100 laps efficiently before you may need to clear the list.

faq.question: Is this stopwatch accurate to the millisecond?
faq.answer: Yes, it uses the device's internal clock to calculate time down to the hundredth of a second for precision.

faq.question: Will the stopwatch keep running if I switch tabs?
faq.answer: Yes, the time is calculated based on absolute timestamps, meaning it remains perfectly accurate even if the tab goes into the background.

cta: Start the stopwatch and track your time!
disclaimer: This tool relies on your device's internal clock and browser performance. Do not use for highly critical timing scenarios.
